pairsWith.noteUz: Infinitiv va -ing shakli mashqlari: bo'shliq to'ldirish, moslash, stop/remember/forget, xat.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 13-UNIT MAShQLAR (63-bet, PDF 62). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '13'.

CHAP USTUN - 'The infinitive - The -ing form':
1) 'Fill in the gaps with to-infinitive, infinitive without to or the -ing form of the verbs in brackets.' 1 Bob wants ...... (send) some flowers to his grandmother on her birthday. 2 I love ...... (listen) to classical music before I go to sleep. 3 Fred is looking forward to ...... (see) his old college friends. 4 My gym teacher made me ...... (do) fifty sit-ups. 5 Steven wants ...... (buy) a farm in the country. 6 I don't mind ...... (help) you with the washing-up. 7 You mustn't ...... (touch) the dog. He bites! 8 Karen refused ...... (lend) Anne her car. 9 I hate ...... (read) scary books late at night. 10 I would like ...... (go) to Brazil and see the Amazon rainforest.
2) 'Match column A to column B to make correct sentences, as in the example.' A: 1 They decided 2 Sam really enjoyed 3 My sister let us 4 I look forward to 5 I couldn't help 6 Joanne hopes 7 The magician made 8 I can't stand 9 You must 10 Mary can. B: a hearing from you soon. b the rabbit disappear for a few minutes. c to sell their old house and buy a bigger one. d watching the play last night. e going to the gym and working out. f brush your teeth at least twice a day. g speak five languages. h noticing that she had dyed her hair. i use her flat for the party. j to become a doctor one day. Namuna: 1 → c.

O'NG USTUN:
3) 'Use the to-infinitive or the -ing form of the verbs in the list to fill in the gaps below.' admire, meet, take, pay, buy, water, cook, pack. 1 Lynn forgot ...... the milkman this morning. 2 She stopped ...... when the phone rang. 3 My grandfather still remembers ...... his first car. 4 They stopped ...... the beautiful view and then drove off. 5 Angie remembered ...... the plants before leaving for the weekend. 6 He forgot ...... his keys with him. 7 I must remember ...... an extra sweater. 8 Paula will never forget ...... Leonardo DiCaprio last summer.
4) 'Read the letter below and put the verbs in brackets into the correct infinitive or -ing form.' (sharlar rasmi) Dear Mike, How are you? I'm writing to you because I would like 1) ...... (invite) you to a party that Paula and I decided 2) ...... (have) on April 25th. Our daughter Joan has just got the position she was after so we want 3) ...... (celebrate) her promotion. Ask Debbie if she fancies 4) ...... (come) along with you, we'd be happy 5) ...... (have) her here as she always makes us 6) ...... (laugh) so much. Do let me 7) ...... (know) if you can make it. I look forward to 8) ...... (see) you again. All the best, Steve

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '63'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with to-infinitive, infinitive without to or the -ing form of the verbs in brackets.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni qavsdagi fe'llarning to-infinitiv, to siz infinitiv yoki -ing shakli bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLDINGI FE'LGA QARANG.

  1 wants TO SEND
  2 love LISTENING
  3 looking forward to SEEING
  4 made me DO (to siz)
  5 wants TO BUY
  6 don't mind HELPING
  7 mustn't TOUCH (modal - to siz)
  8 refused TO LEND
  9 hate READING
  10 would like TO GO


⚠ 'TO LEND':

  = qarzga bermoq (borrow -
  olmoq).


⚠ 'THE AMAZON RAINFOREST':

  = Amazonka tropik o'rmoni.

items.textEn: Bob wants ___ (send) some flowers to his grandmother on her birthday.
I love ___ (listen) to classical music before I go to sleep.
Fred is looking forward to ___ (see) his old college friends.
My gym teacher made me ___ (do) fifty sit-ups.
Steven wants ___ (buy) a farm in the country.
I don't mind ___ (help) you with the washing-up.
You mustn't ___ (touch) the dog. He bites!
I hate ___ (read) scary books late at night.
I would like ___ (go) to Brazil and see the Amazon rainforest.

exercises.instructionEn: Match column A to column B to make correct sentences, as in the example. Example: 1 They decided → c to sell their old house and buy a bigger one.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri gaplar hosil qilish uchun A ustunni B ustunga moslang, namunadagidek. Namuna: 1 They decided → c to sell their old house and buy a bigger one.
exercises.explanationUz:
FE'L ShAKLIGA QARAB MOSLASh.

  1 decided → c TO sell
  2 enjoyed → d WATCHING the play
  3 let us → i USE her flat (to
    siz)
  4 look forward to → a HEARING
  5 couldn't help → h NOTICING
  6 hopes → j TO become
  7 made → b the rabbit DISAPPEAR
    (to siz)
  8 can't stand → e GOING to the
    gym
  9 must → f BRUSH (to siz)
  10 can → g SPEAK (to siz)


⚠ 'TO DYE HAIR':

  = soch bo'yamoq.


⚠ 'TO WORK OUT':

  = mashq qilmoq (sport zalida).

exercises.instructionEn: Use the to-infinitive or the -ing form of the verbs in the list to fill in the gaps below.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi fe'llarning to-infinitiv yoki -ing shakli bilan bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
STOP / REMEMBER / FORGET - MA'NO.

  1 forgot TO PAY the milkman
    (to'lamadi)
  2 stopped COOKING when the
    phone rang (to'xtatdi)
  3 remembers BUYING his first
    car (eslaydi - o'tgan)
  4 stopped TO ADMIRE the view
    (qarash uchun to'xtadi)
  5 remembered TO WATER the plants
    (unutmadi)
  6 forgot TO TAKE his keys
    (olmadi)
  7 must remember TO PACK an
    extra sweater (unutmasligim
    kerak)
  8 will never forget MEETING
    Leonardo DiCaprio (uchrashganini
    hech unutmaydi)


⚠ 'THE MILKMAN':

  = sut tashuvchi.

items.sentence: Lynn forgot ___ the milkman this morning.
items.uz: Linn bugun ertalab sut tashuvchiga to'lashni unutdi. (forget + to = qilmadi)

items.sentence: She stopped ___ when the phone rang.
items.uz: Telefon jiringlaganda u ovqat pishirishni to'xtatdi. (stop + -ing = to'xtatdi)

items.sentence: My grandfather still remembers ___ his first car.
items.uz: Buvam hali ham birinchi mashinasini sotib olganini eslaydi. (remember + -ing = eslaydi)

items.sentence: They stopped ___ the beautiful view and then drove off.
items.uz: Ular go'zal manzaraga qarash uchun to'xtashdi, keyin haydab ketishdi. (stop + to = ... uchun to'xtadi)

items.sentence: Angie remembered ___ the plants before leaving for the weekend.
items.uz: Enji dam olishga ketishdan oldin gullarni sug'orishni unutmadi. (remember + to = unutmadi)

items.sentence: He forgot ___ his keys with him.
I must remember ___ an extra sweater.
items.uz: Qo'shimcha sviter olishni unutmasligim kerak. (remember + to)

items.sentence: Paula will never forget ___ Leonardo DiCaprio last summer.
items.uz: Pola o'tgan yozda Leonardo DiKaprio bilan uchrashganini hech qachon unutmaydi. (forget + -ing = hech unutmaydi)

exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter below and put the verbs in brackets into the correct infinitive or -ing form.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi xatni o'qing va qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri infinitiv yoki -ing shaklida qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
STIVNING XATI - ZIYOFATGA TAKLIF.

  1 would like TO INVITE
  2 decided TO HAVE
  3 want TO CELEBRATE
  4 fancies COMING (fancy + -ing)
  5 be happy TO HAVE (sifat + to)
  6 makes us LAUGH (to siz)
  7 let me KNOW (to siz)
  8 look forward to SEEING


⚠ 'TO FANCY':

  = xohlamoq (fancy + -ing).


⚠ 'A PROMOTION':

  = lavozim ko'tarilishi.


⚠ 'TO MAKE IT':

  = kela olmoq, ulgurmoq.


⚠ 'ALL THE BEST':

  = eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan (xat
  oxiri).

items.textEn: Dear Mike, How are you? I'm writing to you because I would like ___ (invite) you to a party
that Paula and I decided ___ (have) on April 25th.
Our daughter Joan has just got the position she was after so we want ___ (celebrate) her promotion.
Ask Debbie if she fancies ___ (come) along with you,
as she always makes us ___ (laugh) so much.
Do let me ___ (know) if you can make it.
I look forward to ___ (see) you again. All the best, Steve

patterns.formula: KIM + wants / would like / decided / refused + to + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: Bob wants to send some flowers. Karen refused to lend Anne her car.
patterns.exampleUz: Bob gul yubormoqchi. Karen Ennga mashinasini berishdan bosh tortdi.

patterns.exampleEn: My gym teacher made me do fifty sit-ups. My sister let us use her flat.
patterns.exampleUz: O'qituvchim menga ellikta press mashqi qildirdi. Opam kvartirasidan foydalanishga ruxsat berdi.

patterns.formula: KIM + stopped + to FE'L (... uchun to'xtadi) / + FE'L-ing (to'xtatdi)
patterns.exampleEn: They stopped to admire the view. She stopped cooking when the phone rang.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular manzaraga qarash uchun to'xtashdi. Telefon jiringlaganda u ovqat pishirishni to'xtatdi.

patterns.formula: Do let me know if you can make it. I look forward to seeing you.
patterns.exampleEn: Do let me know if you can make it. I look forward to seeing you again.
patterns.exampleUz: Kela olsangiz, xabar bering. Sizni yana ko'rishni intiqlik bilan kutaman.
